corpus.independentOracle: Expected rows are generated before input padding and shuffling; no arm computes its own expected output.

scope.host: Isolated installed Cordis + ToolRuntime, native runtime plugin and native write tools.
scope.timing: Warm process; runtime setup and one warmup excluded; input creation and external acceptance excluded from all arms.
scope.counting: hostDispatches counts actual tools/execute events including runtime_run; writerDispatches counts only native writes; budgetUsage is the persisted run budget.
scope.missingModelCosts: Model token counts and model-loop latency are unknown. Local controls perform no model requests.

existing_model_loop.reason: No real model loop was invoked. local_function is not a substitute.

rule_jev_analysis.reason: Dedicated Jev endpoint, model and matching credential are missing.
